- BlueNova asked for our SOC 2 status, sample breach-notification timeline, and any BCP/DR artifacts we can share for procurement review.
- You mentioned HIPAA scoping for the ePRO pilot and GDPR data subject concerns for EEA patients.
- Next steps agreed: 1) we share a concise IR workflow and evidence pack, 2) you complete our vendor security questionnaire (we'll kick off a tailored copy), 3) schedule a short follow-up with your security lead to confirm notification windows.

Attached: Redwood_IR_Playbook_v2.pdf (condensed playbook), BCP_Summary_Condensed.xlsx (one-page table).

Requesting Ben and Neha to own the docs and timeline: Ben — SOC2 attestation summary and vendor questionnaire draft; Neha — IR timeline and notification thresholds (30/72/90 / escalation cadence).

Emily — could you confirm the security contact who will take the vendor questionnaire (name + email) and your target date for completing it? If you prefer, we can upload the questionnaire to a shared Drive link and you can fill directly.

Best,
Jonas

Hi Emily / Tariq —thanks for the quick reply. Attaching a short-form Vendor Security Questionnaire tailored for clinical customers (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_BlueNova.docx) and a SOC2 attestation summary (SOC2_Attestation_Summary.pdf).

Key notes up front:
- Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II attestation (summary attached). Full report available under NDA; we can fast-track an access request if needed.
- We do support BAAs for HIPAA-covered workflows; draft BAA and dataflow diagrams can be delivered in 3 business days once scope (prod vs. non-prod, PHI types) is confirmed.
- Retention: default embeddings/logs retention is 30 days for hosted by default, with configurable retention policies for Dedicated/Private deployments. We can provide a table of retention options and how they map to encryption-at-rest and key management.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_BlueNova.docx, SOC2_Attestation_Summary.pdf.

Neha — can you prepare the IR timeline mockup (30/72/90 windows + notification escalation matrix) and a one-page BCP evidence list (samples we can share) by EOD tomorrow? I'll coordinate the upload link once ready.

Emily / Tariq — let us know if there's a preferred method for the questionnaire (drive vs docx return).

Thanks,
Ben

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: breach-notification workflow & evidence ask (BlueNova)

Emily / Tariq — attaching the IR timeline mockup and the BCP evidence index. The timeline is intentionally prescriptive to match your procurement checklist:

- T0 (detection): internal triage and classification (within 1 hour), notification to primary on-call.
- T+6–24h (initial containment): assessment and initial customer-facing notification if incident meets notification threshold (we flag PII/PHI exposure or service-impacting outages).
- T+30h (interim report): if investigation ongoing, we provide an interim update with scope and next steps.
- T+72h (detailed notification): final scope estimate and recommended mitigations; provide artifacts (forensics summary, logs subset, if permitted).
- T+7–30d (closure): final report and lessons learned; timeframe depends on complexity.

BCP/DR Evidence index (samples we can share):
- Incident response playbook excerpt (see Redwood_IR_Playbook_v2.pdf)
- Role-based on-call roster and escalation matrix (redacted)
- Sample notification templates (customer + regulator)
- Backup/restore verification matrix and RTO/RPO summary
- Table linking evidence to procurement checklist items

We will upload the artifacts to a read-only Drive folder and share an access link in the next hour. If you need a formal BAA draft, confirm the exact environments and data classes and we'll start the BAA churn.

Cheers,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: IR_Timeline_Mockup.pdf]
[Attachment: BCP_Evidence_Index.pdf]
